reason: The README describes a dsh web plugin focused on app navigation, per-app workspace containers, persistent conversations, and inline rendering of open-mcp-apps widgets.

summaries.zh: 将 open-mcp-apps 应用集成到 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏、独立工作区和聊天内联视图中。
summaries.en: Integrates open-mcp-apps into DeepSeek Harness with sidebar navigation, per-app workspaces, conversations, and inline widget views.

capabilities: Adds sidebar app navigation and app-specific containers in the dsh web interface
Creates and registers per-app local workspaces and conversations
Renders open-mcp-apps widgets inline in chat sessions
Connects dsh to a separately running local open-mcp-apps HTTP engine and MCP client
